{{Quote|You really know how to squeeze the most out of every contract. I admire that. I really do. You are... magnificent.|Caranna, to Tendin Vought|<ref name="displacement">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20041118a|text=Displacement}}</ref>}}
'''Tendin Vought''', known to his employers and targets as '''Razor''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who worked as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. At some point during the conflict, Vought and the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter [[Caranna]] met with a [[Droid/Legends|droid]], who sought to hire the pair to attack a [[Passenger liner/Legends|star liner]]. Caranna was impressed by the way Vought negotiated with the droid, but she suspected that he planned to betray her, so she used a [[drug patch]] to incapacitate Vought. She then offered to complete the droid's job by herself.
